top_choice_rationale: P001 (Buchwald and Hartwig, Pd-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling) combines maturity, three decades of independent confirmation, a clean two-name allocation and real mechanistic novelty beyond the 2010 prize: ligand-controlled C-N reductive elimination from palladium amido intermediates. The 2010 overlap and the Kosugi precursor are matters of citation wording. Protein degradation is a close second, and I prefer the Handa version (P003) to a PROTAC-only citation because the glue strand should not be silently dropped, but no degrader is yet approved and the third name is unsettled.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Warshel and Uppsala ribosome ties involve no proposal on the slate
